🎬 Shots

Type Shot lines in Script (CLOSE ON…, ANGLE ON…, TRACKING SHOT…, WIDE SHOT…) — they sync into this list. Each row can Attach a reference file (photo, PDF, mood board — any type, this browser only). Refresh / Sync re-pulls Script shots. Sketch = starter master + OTS + CU.

Optional scratch notes, name lists for Continuity, and checkpoints. Title page lives under Script → Title page. The core workflow is still Outline → Corkboard ↔ Script. Character profiles stay light (name + optional notes) — not story-theory worksheets.

Optional spine questions — one-sentence answers. They seed Outline/Corkboard when you ask; they never auto-write the Script. SmartType only gets names from Bible/links, not these answers.

Showing short list

Build uses only filled answers. Existing beats with the same spine tag get notes updated; new cards only for major turns if the board has no card for that tag yet.

Parking lot for cut scenes and alternates — not on the main Corkboard. Restore moves a card back to the board.

Format & Continuity Linter — deterministic rules only (no AI). Flags missing INT/EXT or time-of-day, location spelling variants, near-duplicate character names, orphaned parentheticals, empty scenes, and board↔script orphans. Refresh after big edits.

Named checkpoints of the whole project (up to 8). Restoring replaces everything currently open — export first if unsure.

Optional prep. Tag props / wardrobe / etc. per scene — linked to the world catalog (Notes → Props). Scan proposes only; accept to commit. Skip if you only need pages.

Stripboard — shoot order (independent of story order). Strips show eighths, cast IDs, shots & breakdown readiness. Pack by pages/day. Crew is a project roster that feeds every Call sheet; cast/locations/props for a day still auto from that day's scenes. Day packets, DOOD, Card · Script · Shots · BD jumps.

Day INT Day EXT Night INT Night EXT Other Banners / daybreaks sit between strips (shoot order only).

Projects in this browser

WRITEMARE keeps a library of recent projects on this device only (same browser profile). Switching projects autosaves the one you’re leaving. Portable backups are still Export → Save Project.

Welcome to WRITEMARE

WRITEMARE: Keeping writing from becoming a nightmare.
Outline, corkboard, and script — linked, local, offline. Runs in your browser: no account, no install, nothing leaves your computer.

  • Structure + pages together. Outline beats, pin them on the Corkboard, write the Script — Push/Pull keeps card and page aligned.
  • Optional prep when you need it. Shots, breakdown, stripboard, and call sheets stay available under Prep mode; hide them in Write mode.
  • Draft comparison. Checkpoints and Diff revisions show what changed between passes or a collaborator’s file.
  • Share offline. Export an openable .html or project .json. They edit locally; you Compare and pull changes back.
  • Yours to keep. Autosave is in-browser; Export → Save Project is your portable backup. No monthly fee, no uploads.

Pick a starting path (switch anytime)

Outline-first

  1. Load The Dance (or another structure).
  2. Send all beats to Corkboard.
  3. Open a card → write → To Script.

Script / import-first

  1. Open Script — write, or drag in .fountain / .fdx / .pdf.
  2. Cards from Script builds the Corkboard.
  3. Use Diff revisions and Share a copy when you need them.

Export → Save Project keeps a portable backup. Search commands with ⌘K / Ctrl+K.

Settings

Preferences for this browser. Project content still lives in your autosave / exports.

Startup

New project is the default — a clean start each open. Use Projects to open a recent one, or choose Resume last project here to auto-restore the last autosave (or the most recent library project if autosave is empty). Note: each download path of this .html has its own browser storage.

Used when you click + New Project or start with a blank project. Change anytime — does not alter the project currently open.

Writing

Script typing (Final Draft–style): Enter after a character cue goes to dialogue. Accepting SmartType for TIME on a slugline jumps to Action; accepting a Transition jumps to a new scene heading; accepting a Shot jumps to Action — one step, no second Enter. For (O.S.) / (V.O.) type a space then OS or VO (or NAME (os) — glued forms like MANOS are not treated as extensions.

Live toggle for the open script is on the Script rail: # Scene numbers.

When on: cards show Linked / Out of sync / No link, the Script rail shows a Links summary, and the editor warns before overwrite. Push/Pull never run automatically.

Interface

Default for Script. Toggle anytime with ▦ Board on the Script rail (choice is remembered).

On Outline and Script: page progress against your beat goals. Hide with ✕ on the ruler, the Script rail Beat tracker toggle, or here. Restore via Settings or ⌘K → Show beat tracker.

Chrome and boards switch. Also toggle from the header 🌙 / ☀ button. Remembered with your other settings.

When Dark WRITEMARE is on, invert the script page to dark paper / light type for late-night writing. Print and PDF export always stay white paper.

Pin icons on the right of each script line for private notes. Turn off for a cleaner page; notes are kept.

Buttons to store and swap alternate dialogue lines. Off by default for a cleaner page.

On the Script rail (not duplicated here): Element labels, Title page, Typewriter, Focus, Board split, Scene numbers, Bold heads. Corkboard has Compact; Outline has List / Board. Header: theme + per-tab zoom.

Browser AI

When on: agent mirrors are emptied and window.WRITEMARE read/write APIs return protected. Your project stays in local storage; only agent visibility is cut. Turn off to allow closed-loop assistance (focus scene, apply scene, notes).

Backups

Off by default — the browser’s leave dialog cannot be customized, and WRITEMARE already flushes autosave when the tab closes. Turn on only if you want an extra prompt. Uncheck anytime to stop seeing it.

Autosave stays in this browser. Export → Save Project (.json) is your portable file — Load Project reopens it, and (in Chrome/Edge) can link disk autosave so edits write back to that file. Openable (.html) embeds the full app + draft for double-click sharing. Fountain / FDX hand off to Final Draft, Fade In, and similar tools.

Data

Checkpoints (Notes → Checkpoints, or Script Checkpoint) are limited so feature-length scripts fit in browser storage. An Auto checkpoint may save about every 45 minutes while you work (you’ll see a toast). Use Script → Diff revisions to compare against a checkpoint. Share a copy sends an offline .html; Compare collaborator copy diffs their file against yours. Continuity (Notes) flags board↔script orphans. Structure undo is in-session only. Clearing site data can erase the local project — use Export → Save Project for a portable copy.
